quest.title: Stairway to Wangshu
quest.description: Huai'an of Wangshu Inn is trying to fix the crack in the inn staircase, and he's looking for someone to help him...

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: Looks like this is going to need repairing...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's wrong?

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: Ah, it's you. See for yourself — the staircase is broken...

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: It's in pretty bad shape. Someone is definitely going to have an accident if it isn't repaired.

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: How it broke, you ask? Well, a group of monsters tried to get inside, so I came out to fight them off.

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: I should have pulled my punches... I sent one of the big heavy ones flying and he landed right on the staircase. It smashed on impact.

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: I promised myself I'd fix it but I just haven't found the time. Reason being, the inn is just getting busier and busier at the moment. All the more reason why this repair is getting urgent...

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: It's not a difficult job. I can easily repair this myself.

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: If you have the time, could you fetch some Wooden Planks for me? I need to stay here in case someone else misses their step...

response.speaker: Huai'an
response.text: Great. I actually bought the Wooden Planks already, they're currently stored just outside the inn.

response.speaker: Huai'an
response.text: See if you can find them and bring a few back here.

choices.text: Won't it just get smashed again?

response.speaker: Huai'an
response.text: That won't happen. I'm getting old anyway... and I'll make sure I restrain myself next time.

response.speaker: Huai'an
response.text: In any case, it needs fixing whatever happens. I actually bought the Wooden Planks already, they're currently stored just outside the inn.

response.speaker: Huai'an
response.text: Please bring a few of them here for me.

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: Found them?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Not yet.

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: They're just outside, they can't be that hard to find.

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: Go and take a look. I need to stay here in case someone else comes rushing past and has an accident...

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: Found them?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Yes.

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: Let's see... Yes, that should be enough. Thanks.

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: Right, I should get to work. I need to repair this as quickly as I can...

talks.objective: Watch the repairing of the bridge

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: There, that should do it. I don't think anyone's going to fall on this.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It doesn't match the style though...

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: Not much I can do about that. I'm not some sort of master craftsman, you know.

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: Wait... That was only one of them. There's another hole I still need to fix...

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: Oh well, that will have to do for today. The inn is still open and I need to go back to serving the guests.

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: No matter how badly it needs fixing, business is business... Thanks for your help. Take this for your trouble.
